ios.desc:
Stop Giving Free Rides !

Join thousands of drivers who are finally getting compensated for their time, gas, and emotional labor. You love your girlfriend. You love your friends. You love road trips. You do not love paying for everyone’s fuel.

No Free Ride is the fun and simple way to split car costs, track mileage, and share fuel expenses without becoming the unpaid chauffeur. Whether you’re driving your girlfriend to brunch, picking up friends for a night out, organizing a carpool to work, or heading out on a weekend road trip, this app makes sure everyone pays their share.
Track every trip automatically, calculate gas or petrol costs, and instantly split car expenses between passengers. No awkward math. No “I forgot.” No chasing people for fuel money. Just clear, fair cost sharing.

What you can do:

• Track mileage and distance for every ride
• Calculate fuel costs in seconds
• Split gas, petrol, tolls, and parking
• See exactly what each person owes
• Share simple ride summaries
•  Send Taxi style bill to passengers
• Make carpool cost sharing effortless

Perfect for daily commuters, couples, roommates, coworkers, road trip crews, and anyone tired of funding everyone else’s transport budget.
No Free Ride combines trip tracking, mileage recording, fuel cost calculation, and expense splitting in one easy app. It’s built for real-life driving, real-life friends, and real-life fuel bills.

Love is free. Driving isn’t. Stop giving free rides. Start splitting car costs the smart way.
